name: Aisha Verma (fictional test profile)
summary: Final-year B.Tech (CSE) student who turns messy data into dashboards and decisions.

bullets.text: Built a Power BI dashboard tracking daily orders and returns for 3 city warehouses, used by the ops team in weekly reviews
Wrote SQL queries to find the top 20 return reasons, which led ops to change packaging for 2 product lines
Cleaned 1.2 lakh rows of order data in Python (Pandas), cutting manual Excel work for the team by about 4 hours a week
Analysed 15 seasons of IPL ball-by-ball data in Python and showed toss decisions had a weak link to match results
Presented findings to 60 students at the college data club

education: B.Tech Computer Science, RV College (fictional record), 2027 expected, CGPA 8.4
